hooks.name: Run Tests on Save
hooks.description: Run the test suite for the saved test file and report pass/fail.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi

echo "=== Test run triggered by: $FILE ==="

case "$FILE" in
  *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx)
    if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
      # Vitest (preferred) or Jest — single run, no watch
      if npx --no-install vitest --version &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
        npx --no-install vitest run --reporter=verbose "$FILE" 2>&1
      elif npx --no-install jest --version &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
        npx --no-install jest --no-coverage --testPathPattern="$FILE" 2>&1
      else
        echo "No JS test runner found (vitest or jest). Skipping."
      fi
    fi
    ;;
  *.py)
    if command -v pytest &>/dev/null; then
      pytest -v "$FILE" 2>&1
    else
      echo "pytest not found. Skipping."
    fi
    ;;
esac

STATUS=$?
if [ $STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "✅ Tests passed"
else
  echo "❌ Tests failed (exit $STATUS)"
fi
exit $STATUS
